policies.title: Uruguayan citizens: citizenship entry status
policies.summary: Uruguay's Foreign Ministry supplies a one-way return travel document to Uruguayan nationals or legal citizens whose travel document is unavailable. An ordinary Uruguayan passport therefore represents citizenship, not a foreign visitor-visa route.
conditions: This is supported by the Foreign Ministry's direct return-document route, rather than inferred solely from matching catalog codes.
It does not determine treatment of a dual national presenting a different passport, individual document-validity issues, departure controls, residence, or any foreign visitor status.

unresolved.reason: The current Interior schedule's residual sentence covers countries not listed, but it does not identify Kosovo or map this catalog's Kosovo ordinary-passport issuer. Do not extend the residual rule to this territorial/document case without direct official mapping.
